workflows.name: How to Open a Markdown File on iPhone or iPad
workflows.description: If an AI chatbot, GitHub repo, or note app gives you a .md file, iOS may show plain text instead of a useful preview. This guide gives you the shortest reliable path. Open the App Store link and install the one-purpose Markdown viewer. Choose Md Preview from the iOS Share Sheet or open the file directly. The Markdown renders on your device, including technical content.
workflows.source: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GitHub, Obsidian, Notion
workflows.query: How to Open a Markdown File on iPhone or iPad
workflows.primaryKeyword: how to open Markdown file on iPhone

step.name: Install Md Preview
step.text: Open the App Store link and install the one-purpose Markdown viewer.

step.name: Find the Markdown file
step.text: Use Files, Mail, ChatGPT export, GitHub, Obsidian, Notion, or cloud storage.

step.name: Tap Share
step.text: Choose Md Preview from the iOS Share Sheet or open the file directly.

step.name: Read the rendered preview
step.text: The Markdown renders on your device, including technical content.

workflows.name: How to Open ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini Markdown Files on iPhone
workflows.description: Install Md Preview, open the file from Files or the iOS Share Sheet, and preview it locally on iPhone or iPad.
workflows.query: How do I open an AI-generated Markdown file on iPhone or iPad?
workflows.primaryKeyword: open ChatGPT Markdown file on iPhone

step.name: Save the source file
step.text: Save the Markdown file from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini. Keep the original .md, .markdown, .mdx, .rmd, .qmd file available in Files, Mail, a browser download, or the source app.

step.name: Open the iOS Share Sheet
step.text: Save the .md file, open it from Files or the Share Sheet, and choose Md Preview to render it locally.

step.name: Choose the viewer
step.text: Choose Md Preview as the target viewer. It opens the file locally on iPhone or iPad for this workflow: open an AI-generated Markdown file.

step.name: Preview and check
step.text: Use this path when you need readable headings, lists, links, code blocks, math, or Mermaid instead of plain text.
